subject: Reorder valkey.conf: move configs to correct sections (#2737)
reason: The change only reorders commented-out documentation blocks inside valkey.conf (availability-zone, server-cpulist/bio-cpulist/aof-rewrite-cpulist/bgsave-cpulist, ignore-warnings) into their correct sections. Every moved line begins with '#'; no active config directive or server code changes, so server behaviour, replies, persistence and replication are identical and there is nothing a scenario could reach.
